Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
TRACHEOSTOMY TUBES, FULLER'S PATTERN 



( Reaffirmed 1998) 



1. Scope— Covers dimensional and other requirements for Fuller's pattern tracheostomy tubes used 
in ENT surgery. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Table 1 .

2.1 A deviation of ±2-5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 

3. Sizes — Fuller's tube shall be of 9 sizes, that is, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 26, 28, 30 and 32. 

4. Material — Tubes shall be of silver alloy (92% Ag 8% Cu) conforming to IS : 21 1 2-1 962 'Specification 
for grades of silver and silver.alloys'. 

5. Workmanship and Finish 

5.1 Externa! surfaces shall be smooth, free from flaws or surface irregularities and shall be polished bright. 

5.2 Soldered surfaces shall be finished smooth. 



Adopted 5 May 1976

gejJ 



IS: 81 99-1976 

5.3 All edges shall be rounded and finished smooth. 

5.4 The inner tube shall fit snugly and smoothly in the outer tube. 

6. Corrosion Resistance Test — The Fuller's tube shall be immersed in a 10 percent solution of citric 
acid at room temperature for 5 hours. It shall then be boiled in distilled water for 30 minutes and cooled 
while immersed in the same water for 48 hours. The Fuller's tube shall show no sign of corrosion. 
The test shall be conducted in glass container. 

7. Marking — The Fuller's tubes shall be marked with the following: 

a) Manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark; and 

b) The size of the tube on the flanges. 

7.1 AS/ Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — The Fuller's tubes of the same size shall be packed suitably in cardboard cartons. The 
Fuller's tubes may also be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Printed at Sree Saraswaty Press Ltd, Calcutta 700 009
